name: Saint Irenaeus
history: A Greek from Smyrna who as a boy listened to Saint Polycarp, the disciple of Saint John, and became bishop of Lyons in Gaul. His great work Against Heresies refuted the Gnostics by appealing to Scripture and to the faith handed down in the churches from the apostles. Pope Francis named him a Doctor of the Church, the Doctor of Unity, in 2022.
life: Irenaeus remembered in old age how Polycarp used to describe his conversations with John and others who had seen the Lord. He went west to Lyons as a priest, and in 177 was sent to Rome with a letter to Pope Eleutherius. While he was away a fierce persecution broke out, and the aged bishop Pothinus died in prison with many of his flock. Irenaeus returned to become bishop in his place. Against the Gnostics, who claimed secret knowledge and despised the material world, he insisted on the one God who made heaven and earth, on the true flesh of Christ, and on the tradition preserved in the churches by the succession of bishops, giving the list of the bishops of Rome. When Pope Victor threatened to cut off the churches of Asia over the date of Easter, Irenaeus urged him to keep the peace. He is honoured as a martyr, though how he died is not known.
prayerTo: Saint Irenaeus, you received the faith from those who had known the apostles and handed it on whole. Pray for the unity of the Church, for teachers of the faith, and for me, that I may love creation as God’s gift and believe all that He has revealed. Amen.
penance: Pray the Apostles’ Creed slowly today, pausing on each line, and do one thing to heal a division in your family or parish.
meditation: The glory of God is a living man, Irenaeus wrote, and the life of man is the vision of God. Where are you most fully alive?
